summary: Two-card showcase: 'Original' card top, 'Edited' card bottom on red radial; the Original plays once (4-10.5 s) and is blank white otherwise in this downloaded copy; the Edited card does all the work with stickers every ~1 s.
8 s of dead time (10.5-19 s): do NOT copy; our version fills it with the edit playing.
End card: 'DM to / Edited by <name> / Hire me' on the same red bg.
make_it_ours: Background: paper/studio texture (not flat red radial)
Own handle + own stickers, own footage in the cards
Fill the Original card for the whole first half, Edited plays on beat in the second half
Label font: heavy grotesk, not pixel font
